title: Ski Resorts Have Been Firing Army Guns at the Snow for 75 Years. The Guns Are Going Back.
description: On stormy mornings, before the lifts open, ski patrols out West fire military guns into the snow to start avalanches on purpose. Here is how it works, why the Army wants its guns back, and what happens to the shells that never go off.
share_title: Why the Army Is Taking Back the Ski Resorts' Guns
share_description: For more than 75 years, ski resorts out West have fired military guns at their own mountains before the lifts open. Here is why the guns are going back, and where the shells that never go off end up.
dek: For more than 75 years, ski resorts out West have opened fire on their own mountains before the first chair. The guns belong to the Army, and the Army wants them back.
